post.originalText:
Kimi K3.1 Pro just made the jelliest jelly ever. For $1.50

Same prompt: rainbow jelly you can cut, nail and torch.

Kimi K3.1 Pro - $1.50, 17 min
Opus 5.5 - $8.00, 52 min

Look at the colors. And the shadows are real: every layer casts its own color on the table.

Opus took 3x longer and cost 5x more for this.

Would you still pay for Opus?

sourceMaterials.text: @zipeng365 nope, one prompt each, no fixes. that's the full bill
sourceMaterials.author: 0xRhinoX

sourceMaterials.text: @0xOrionVega only tested jelly so far, but it's tied with Opus on Terminal-Bench

sourceMaterials.text: @0chob not sure yet, I only have the total time. if most of it went into testing its own jelly, I'd mind the 52 min a lot less

sourceMaterials.text: @velesxbt yeah that's fair. what kind of agent work do you mean? I'd give both the same task and see which one fails first
